additional_concerns: Footnote 3 has supplied anchors in both the XML option (da12aecad4e68.u4.1003) and prescribed-PDF option (da12aecad4e68.u5.1078). The extraction's uncertainty that the anchors are absent is resolved by the whole packet. Neither anchor establishes a universal e-Cert requirement for web-form submissions.

The date-only candidate node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes filings before 9:00am on 2 February 2026. The other candidates use operational launch. Preserve the competing readings of “With effect from 2 February 2026” and “following its implementation”; the date-only rule cannot distinguish the final hours of the blackout.

The governing timezone is not expressly supplied. Exact-instant classifications need an established timezone basis; none of the anonymous missing dependency IDs can safely be matched to that authority.

Registration, XML-schema compliance and e-Cert use are not stated conditions of the resubmission trigger. Their absence from these trigger formulas neither establishes submission compliance nor permits disregarding those separate duties.

Candidates placing actual STR filing in scope return OUT_OF_SCOPE for nonfiling events; node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb instead can return FALSE. Clarify whether the typed event domain excludes nonfilings before treating these outputs as equivalent.

The history candidate delegates event identification, temporal interpretation and completeness to an external Boolean aggregate. FALSE requires sufficient history; a later compliant resubmission does not erase the historical trigger or establish that a duty remains outstanding.

The circular promises JFIU resubmission guidance, but that guidance is absent and has no identifiable dependency mapping. It may be needed to assess performance or discharge of resubmission, rather than the historical trigger addressed here.
No supplied external dependency has a non-null source_hash. These scoped findings do not validate the candidates as complete implementations.
